newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, likely profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, likely profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be mixed on Monday with possible profit-taking after the index closed at a record 736.60 points on Friday , brokers said.
"After the index rose almost three percent on the week, technically there should be a correction today," the head broker with a local firm said.
But brokers said the market still had an upside potential as some fundamentally-sound stocks remained undervalued.
They expected the market would keep an eye open for the latest deregulation package due to be announced this week.
"Some investors may continue to speculate on what sector of industry will benefit most from the package," a broker said.
Blue chip Citra Marga might attract market attention following a report in Bisnis Indonesia that Krakatau Steel had sold 2.89 percent of its stake in the toll road operator.
On Friday, the Jakarta composite index closed at a record 736.60 points against the previous week's close of 716.83 points, up 2.76 percent on the week.
